hypothesis: A shared Adam displacement can undo a class-specific positive own-private update while total member CE improves; protecting that finite post-private class progress may strengthen members and improve the fixed pool.
distinction_from_molecular18: Shared update-map intervention with fixed plain own CE, rather than own/pool objective placement.
private_update: Unchanged ordinary source-scaled native Adam proposal from original two-view mean own CE.
shared_reference_proposal: Actual native Adam displacement u0 from the original ordinary gradients and states.
eligibility: Present TRAIN member/class pair whose deterministic class CE strictly improves from old state to B; correctness not required.
projection: Minimize ||u-u0||²/2 subject to gradient_shared class_CE(B) dot u <=0 for every active pair.
finite_guard: At B, accept first scale1,1/2,1/4,1/8 with no active class CE or member total CE increase; otherwise shared u=0. Empty active roster uses ordinary u0.
optimizer_state: Advance native ordinary-gradient Adam moments once; separately retain proposed versus applied shared displacements.
protected_quantity: Class risk after the current private update, not private-gain magnitude, full tangent span, future learnability, or development competence.
common_competitor_rationale: Own CE can improve truth probabilities before any correct specialist exists; prevent subsequent shared erasure of those class gains.

representative_plan.depends_on: Running objective-placement study leaves a material member deficit and root separately freezes this screen.

primary_mechanism_control: Whole-member post-private projection with otherwise identical state, finite guard, and private learning.
stop_criteria: No meaningful positive private class progress or class cancellation
Whole-member projection or PCGrad matches useful gain
Shared errors move without useful net repairs
Served gain or NLL safeguard fails
Apparent gain attributable to generic class restraint in a capable single
screen_success_not_confirmation: Positive paired served differences against native and whole-member projection in all3 seeds, improved mean/worst competence, no worse mean served NLL; preserve developmental optimism and one-graph limits.
